title: TaskCompletedV1Data
description: Event payload schema for com.system.task.completed.v1 worker completion event

taskId.description: Unique identifier of the completed task (UUID).

executionDurationMs.description: Elapsed execution duration in milliseconds spent processing the task.

status.description: Terminal execution status reported by the worker.

result.description: Structured execution output, artifact references, or summary metrics produced by the worker.

completedAt.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 timestamp when worker execution concluded.

error.description: Error diagnostic details provided when status is FAILED or TIMED_OUT.

details.description: Additional error context, parameters, or diagnostic info.
